purpose: Increase repair throughput by closing normal anchor attestation, provider monotonic floor, journal crash recovery and recovery-audit rollback detection in one bounded shadow tranche.

provider_model.provider_state: logically provider-owned monotonic floor with authenticated last anchor/audit state

required_semantics: Every normal matched local anchor can receive a provider-authenticated attestation bound to exact anchor hash, anchor sequence, ledger head, installation, runtime, mission and step.
Provider attestations form a contiguous authenticated chain with provider_seq and previous_attestation_hash.
Provider state is the monotonic floor for the consumer journal; rolling the consumer journal behind provider state fails closed.
A crash after provider state commit but before consumer-journal commit can reconcile exactly one already-issued provider receipt; larger divergence fails closed.
All provider-state mutations use one provider writer lock in the v0.2 safe API.
Recovery audit registry is canonically hashed and authenticated into provider state; registry rollback/tamper relative to the current provider state fails closed.
Recovery audit attestation must be rebound after the current anchor attestation advances.
Provider/anchor/audit maintenance creates zero Experience and zero operational progress.
acceptance_tests: consumer journal rollback detected by provider floor
exact one missing journal receipt recoverable from provider state
recovery audit registry rollback or tamper detected
recovery audit becomes stale after anchor attestation advances
provider state mutation lock contention fails closed
known_remaining_gaps: The provider state is represented by a local shadow file; if provider state and consumer state are rolled back together, this model cannot prove detection without a genuinely independent monotonic trust service.
Synthetic HMAC test material is public regression material and must never be treated as a production credential.
Provider state crash recovery beyond the modeled one-receipt journal gap remains TEST_REQUIRED.
Distributed multi-host lease/consensus is absent; the current lock is local cross-process only.
Live v2/v2.1 still do not consume this shadow provider evidence and remain bounded-veto candidate code.
Fresh exact-current CI execution evidence is still required before any shadow PASS claim.
release_rule: This shadow candidate may only inform a later bounded A->B->C proposal after exact tests and independent review. It cannot directly promote live Gearbox v2/v2.1.
